{{Quote|She did it. She poisoned the air, punctured the crust&mdash;I don't know how&hellip;|Ngani Zho|<ref name="Lost Suns 3" />}}
'''Vesla Two''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]]<ref name="Lost Suns 3" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Corosi sector/Legends|Corosi sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It could originally support life, but the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Mekhis]] tested one of her new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] on the planet and caused catastrophic atmospheric damage&mdash;enough to draw a colony of [[Shyrack/Legends|shyrack]] broodlings.<ref name="Lost Suns 3" />
